entities.name: Daisuke Satō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daisuke Satō  was a Japanese board game designer, novelist, manga and ecchi writer. He was known for his alternate history novels Seito and Red Sun Black Cross, among others. He wrote the story for his manga Imperial Guards and Highschool of the Dead. Imperial Guards was nominated for the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2007 and for the first Manga Taishō in 2008. He died on March 22, 2017, from ischaemic heart disease. After Daisuke's death, the decision was made to leave Highschool of the Dead unfinished.
